stories.h: Coastal flood warning, wind advisory hit Puget Sound Thanksgiving
stories.s: Early-morning king tides plus storm winds bring a coastal flood warning to Puget Sound shores and a wind advisory through noon, with inland gusts to 45-50 mph. Expect scattered outages; afternoon turns drier.

stories.h: SPU deploys pumps, sandbags as king tides flood South Park
stories.s: Seattle Public Utilities activated its emergency plan after high water reached South Park basements, staffing a base at 8th Ave S and S Monroe St and five sandbag pickup sites. Residents should move cars to higher ground.

stories.h: Environmental group sues King County over West Point plant
stories.s: Puget Soundkeeper Alliance filed a federal suit alleging the West Point treatment plant discharges nitrogen and phosphorus into Puget Sound without valid permit coverage. It seeks a halt to discharges and daily civil penalties.

stories.h: Downed trees cut power to 900 near Lake City
stories.s: About 900 Seattle City Light customers in Olympic Hills lost power for roughly six hours Wednesday after trees fell on lines; service returned around 12:30 p.m. as utilities prepped for the overnight storm.

coming.h: Another, weaker round of rain Friday
coming.s: Rain returns Friday before clearing in the evening; the weekend looks drier, with more rain early next week.

coming.h: Court hearing on blocking I-638 girls' sports rules
coming.s: King County Superior Court Judge Maureen McKee hears a bid to halt Initiative 638 at 9 a.m., the day the measure takes effect.
